commits.title: Compare stored image buffers as bytes
commits.before_text: The changelog image test compared a database-backed buffer directly with raw image bytes.
commits.after_text: The regression assertion converts the stored image buffer to bytes before comparison, supporting the PostgreSQL-backed image representation.
